blind.description: A stylized wooden potting bench with multiple tiers. The main wooden frame features four corner posts secured with bolt details and a solid wooden backboard. The top raised shelf holds four small terracotta pots (containing green leafy plants, white blossoms, and purple buds) alongside a coiled ball of twine. The main working tabletop has a loose pile of potting soil, a stack of terracotta pots, two potted seedlings, and a small dark wooden tool caddy. The lower bottom shelf stores a tied burlap sack of soil/fertilizer featuring a green leaf logo and a blue utility bucket with a wooden handle grip. All surfaces are solid, stylized, and fully textured with hand-painted wood grain and materials.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden structure viewed top-down; along the top edge sits a narrow shelf displaying a row of five small potted items and a twine spool; beneath it, the main shelf shows a dark spread of soil on the left, central terracotta pots, and an open wooden tool tray on the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: About two-thirds as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 3.8 to 4 feet high) and roughly 3.5 to 4 feet wide.
